connectionSettings.title: Model Connection & Multimodal Transport
connectionSettings.subtitle: Configure WebSocket delta transport, prompt-cache affinity, and image URL offloading (blob-broker) for global defaults or individual workspaces.
connectionSettings.guideTitle: Why Connection Architecture Matters in Multimodal Loops
connectionSettings.guideSummary: In a continuous game loop, the agent observes a new screenshot every turn. After 60 turns, history reaches 6–9 MB of images — making transport statefulness and vision preprocessing the primary determinants of turn latency.
connectionSettings.guideDocLink: Read transport & WS recovery deep dive
connectionSettings.tierWsBody: Supported by OpenAI Codex Responses over WebSocket. The server keeps session state across turns; the client sends only the latest step's delta. Historical screenshots are neither re-uploaded nor re-encoded by the vision tower.
connectionSettings.tierCacheBody: Used by stateless /v1/chat/completions and /v1/messages endpoints. Even when LLM token KV cache hits (>90% cache_read), stateless multimodal gateways often re-run Vision Encoder preprocessing on every historical image before checking the LLM cache (~300–400 ms/image × 60 images ≈ 20s+ per turn). Pair stateless endpoints with a lower compactionThreshold.
connectionSettings.tierBlobBody: Publishes local perception blobs via Provider Files API, local reverse tunnels (cloudflared / tailscale), or ephemeral hosts (uguu / tmpfiles), replacing inline Base64 with short URLs. Solves local upload bandwidth bottlenecks and automatically falls back to inline Base64 if a provider rejects URLs.
connectionSettings.scopeHint: Global defaults apply to newly initialized workspaces and any workspace without an explicit connection override.
connectionSettings.statusInherited: Inheriting global / OMP defaults (no workspace override stored)
connectionSettings.statusOverridden: Custom workspace connection override active in ludens.json
connectionSettings.statusGlobalActive: Custom global connection defaults active in config.json
connectionSettings.wsHint: Controls stateful WebSocket delta transport for OpenAI Codex models. Auto uses WebSocket when supported with a 60s cooldown recovery on transient drops.
connectionSettings.wsAuto: Auto — follow model default (WebSocket delta with SSE recovery)
connectionSettings.wsOn: On — force WebSocket transport for Codex models
connectionSettings.wsOff: Off — disable WebSocket, always send full history over HTTP SSE
connectionSettings.cacheHint: Forwarded to providers that support cache TTL controls (Anthropic, Bedrock, OpenRouter, OpenAI Responses).
connectionSettings.cacheAuto: Auto — provider default (Anthropic OAuth 1h, API keys 5m)
connectionSettings.cacheLong: Long (1h+) — extended TTL for longer pauses between turns
connectionSettings.cacheNone: None — disable prompt caching and cache-affinity routing
connectionSettings.appendHint: Keep an append-only message log and stable system/tool prefix so RadixAttention / prefix KV caches (DeepSeek, SGLang, Anthropic) hit at maximum rate.
connectionSettings.appendAuto: Auto — enable for known prefix-cache providers (recommended)
connectionSettings.imageUrlsDesc: Publish outgoing screenshots through the ordered backend chain below instead of sending multi-megabyte inline Base64 on every HTTP turn.
connectionSettings.imageUrlsModeInherit: Inherit global / OMP default (Off unless globally enabled)
connectionSettings.imageUrlsModeOn: On — publish images as URLs / provider file refs with inline fallback
connectionSettings.backendsHint: OMP tries enabled backends in order and automatically falls back to the next backend or inline Base64 if upload or provider fetch fails.
